ruleDefinitions.name: Suspect Svchost Activity
ruleDefinitions.description: It is extremely abnormal for svchost.exe to spawn without any CLI arguments and is normally observed when a malicious process spawns the process and injects code into the process memory space.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX("svchost\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\svchost\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rpcnet\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rpcnetp\\\.exe$")) OR process_command_line = "None"))
